_nameVariantsNote: Every spelling people actually use — full names, the short form Nour Tofi / نور طفي, both handles, and the توفي misspelling. Emitted as schema.org alternateName and listed in llms.txt / llms-full.txt / api/profile.json, so a search or a model that meets any variant resolves to the same person. This does not endorse them — profile.name stays canonical.

tagline.en: I turn messy manual processes into self-running workflows, and build the interfaces people use on top of them.
tagline.ar: أُحوّل العمليات اليدوية المتعثّرة إلى مسارات عمل ذاتية التشغيل، وأبني الواجهات التي يستخدمها الناس فوقها.

_imageNote: The portrait. 720×720, downscaled from me.png. Feeds Person.image in the structured data, the header avatar (via the 96px copy) and the full-size view behind it.

_ogImageNote: Generated 1200×630 share card, emitted as og:image / twitter:image so links unfurl with a real preview. Wider than the portrait and captioned, so it stays the share image rather than the photo.
